otherConditions: Bachelor's degree from an institutionally accredited U.S. institution required. Minimum cumulative CASPA GPA 3.0 and minimum prerequisite math/science GPA 3.0. GRE General Test required (CASPA GRE code 0957; scores valid within 5 years of matriculation). Patient care experience within 5 years of matriculation required (no minimum hours; proof on employer letterhead). Two letters of recommendation, including at least one from a practicing PA or physician (MD/DO). At application, no more than three outstanding prerequisites (no more than two counting toward M/S GPA). All prerequisites complete by December 31 of the application year. Human Anatomy and Human Physiology must be within 5 years of matriculation; most other science/statistics/medical terminology within 10 years. No work/life, CLEP, technical, or vocational credit accepted in place of prerequisites. AP/CCP may be accepted if within 10 years and reported individually on official college transcripts. See also https://www.ohio.edu/chsp/physician-assistant/admissions

courses.name: Human Anatomy with lab
courses.details: Must be Human Anatomy. A&P 1 and 2 combination accepted (both required for full anatomy exposure; second course may apply to Human Physiology). Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 5 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Human Physiology
courses.details: Lab preferred but not required. A&P 2 combination accepted. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 5 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Biology I & II with labs
courses.details: Acceptable: Cellular Biology, Molecular Biology, Ecology, Molecules and Cells, Genetics, Botany, Zoology. Must include laboratory. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Microbiology with lab
courses.details: Acceptable: Immunology, Micro-Organisms. Must include laboratory. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Chemistry I & II with labs
courses.details: Acceptable: Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry II, Physical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medical Chemistry. Must include laboratory. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Organic Chemistry I with lab
courses.details: Organic Chemistry I or II. Must contain laboratory or take lab separately. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Biochemistry
courses.details: Acceptable: Biological Chemistry, Biomolecules, Metabolism, Nutritional Chemistry. Laboratory not required. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: Statistics
courses.details: Acceptable: Intro to Statistics, Biostatistics, Stats for the Behavioral Sciences, Biometry, Quantitative Methods in Psychology. Calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: College Algebra
courses.details: Acceptable: Trigonometry, Pre-Calculus, Calculus. Calculated in M/S GPA. No expiration date.

courses.name: Medical Terminology
courses.details: Certificate courses not accepted. NOT calculated in M/S GPA. Within 10 years of matriculation.

courses.name: General Psychology
courses.details: Acceptable: Introduction to Psychology. NOT calculated in M/S GPA. No expiration date.

courses.name: Developmental or Abnormal Psychology
courses.details: Acceptable: Abnormal Psychology, Child/Adolescent/Lifespan Development, Human Growth and Development, Physiological Psychology, Neuropsychology. NOT calculated in M/S GPA. No expiration date.
